name: Rasmus Hellmund Carlsen
profile: Danish marketer who co-founded Copenhagen payments company Flatpay in 2022 with Sander Janca-Jensen, Rasmus Busk and Peter Lüth and runs its marketing. Flatpay sells flat-fee card terminals to small merchants, passed 1,000 employees within about three years and reached a €1.5B valuation after a €145M round.
interesting_fact: On leadership he has said: 'When people are given responsibility, they must treat others with respect' — Flatpay aimed to pass 1,000 employees in 2025.
deep_cut_fact: Before Flatpay his career ran through Danish financial-comparison site Samlino.dk, ride-sharing platform GoMore and Verisure/Securitas Direct — i.e. consumer marketplaces before payments.

public_contacts.value: christian.gronning@flatpay.dk (Christian Grønning, Global Head of Communications)

notes: Also appears as 'Rasmus Carlsen' and as an angel investor (nordic9). Career history from theorg.com (unverified aggregator) — companies listed without dates/roles.

name: André Gregori
current_role: Listed as Octane co-founder; current role unclear (formerly VP Product per Wellfound)
profile: Named as a co-founder of Octane (Octane Lending, Inc.), the New York powersports/RV financing fintech founded in 2014 with CEO Jason Guss. A Wellfound listing gave his title as VP Product; he does not appear on Octane's current leadership list, and little else about him is public.

notes: Co-founder status confirmed by Preqin (https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/octane-lending-inc-/143084) and Wellfound, but personal details are scarce; may no longer be at Octane. Web-search budget exhausted before deeper research.

name: Volodymyr Kuznetsov
profile: Security researcher (EPFL PhD 2016 under George Candea; previously a researcher at UC Berkeley) who co-founded data-security company Cyberhaven in 2016 and was its first CEO, moving to CTO when Howard Ting became CEO in 2021. Cyberhaven sells data-lineage-based data loss prevention and is valued at $1B+.
interesting_fact: He was the first author of 'Code-Pointer Integrity' (OSDI 2014, with Dawn Song, Mathias Payer and Candea), a defence against control-flow hijacking.
deep_cut_fact: The SafeStack protection from his Code-Pointer Integrity work was upstreamed into LLVM/Clang, so it ships in a mainstream compiler; he also co-authored the original S2E symbolic-execution papers.

public_contacts.value: Guest on SC Media 'Founder Stories' FS #13 (founder-led to professional CEO transition)

notes: Goes by 'Vova'. Has done podcasts and bylines (SC Media, GovInfoSecurity) — likely receptive to podcast outreach via Cyberhaven press.
